dealSummary: Sydney-based Firmus, an AI infrastructure company, raised $2 billion at a valuation above $10.5 billion from investors including Coatue, Nvidia and Blackstone.
Whatnot, the developer of a live shopping marketplace, raised a $545 million Series G at a $20 billion valuation led by Iconiq, Lightspeed and Avra.
Harvey, a legal tech startup, is in talks to raise $500 million at a valuation of $15.5 billion, The Information reported.
Jeff Bezos-backed Slate Auto, a developer of low-cost electric pickup trucks, is raising around $500 million in a Series D, Axios reported.

Panthalassa, a developer of wave-energy technology to power offshore AI data centers, is raising $225 million at a $2 billion valuation in a round led by 8090 Industries and Hanwha Asset Management, The Information reported.
leadInvestors: 8090 Industries, Hanwha Asset Management, The Information reported

dealSummary: Munich-based spatial intelligence startup NavVis raised an $85 million Series D led by TJC.
AI-driven customer service startup Omilia received a $67 million Series B led by Expedition Growth Capital.
Naïve, which builds infrastructure for AI agents, raised a $28.5 million Series A led by Nexus Venture Partners.
